cover.report_type: Interim Report: Seven days before a primary election

_meta.notes: The FORM checks 'Seven days before a primary election'; the clerk listing calls this the June interim. Neither amendment box is checked. Signed 6-14-10, clerk-stamped RECEIVED JUN 15 2010; Summary Page header 'DeBry, 6-14-10, page 2 of 4'. Both columns reconcile exactly (4,400.00 + 2,384.85 = 6,784.85; less 1,674.85 = 5,110.00 = 7,453.46 - 2,343.46), and Line 3 chains from the April interim's 'N/A'-opening report.

contributions.detail: exact (2,384.85 = 2,384.85): the 14 rows sum to 2,384.85, matching both the printed page SUBTOTAL and the stated Summary-Page figure. NOTE the schedule's own 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)' line prints $7,453.46 on this single-page schedule - a cumulative/campaign-to-date figure, not the sum of this filing's pages; retained verbatim, never reconciled

expenditures.detail: exact (1,674.85 = 1,674.85): the 7 rows sum to 1,674.85, matching the printed page SUBTOTAL and the stated figure. The schedule's TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE line prints $2,343.46 - again a cumulative figure on a single-page schedule, kept verbatim

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 14 rows sum 2,384.85 = printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE $2,384.85 - GATE FIRED, exact; p4 7 rows sum 1,674.85 = printed SUBTOTAL $1,674.85 - GATE FIRED, exact. Both pages' TOTAL lines (7,453.46 / 2,343.46) DO NOT equal their subtotals - they are cumulative figures and were deliberately NOT used as gates.
itemized.escalation_note: p3 Name cells for rows 3 and 14 cropped at 800 dpi - both surnames run into the county redaction block and remain clipped; neither was completed
itemized.notes: ADDRESS COLUMN IS COUNTY-REDACTED on Schedule A: a white block covers the entire Complete Mailing Address column (a few stray digits bleed at its edges). All donor_city/donor_state are therefore blank with 'redacted' stated - distinct from a filer leaving the column empty. The redaction block also clips the right end of the two longest names (rows 3 and 14), which are left incomplete rather than guessed. This filer is one of the known DeBry cases where a TOTAL line carries a CUMULATIVE figure: on both schedules the 'sum of subtotals from all pages' line is much larger than the single page's subtotal ($7,453.46 vs $2,384.85; $2,343.46 vs $1,674.85), so only the page subtotals were used as gates and both closed exactly. Schedule A row 12 and Schedule B row 7 are the two halves of the same $825.38 in-kind printing from the SL Board of Realtors. A hand-drawn brace sits in the left margin of Schedule B beside the two 4-23-10 rows, with no legend. Cents are written as superscripts over a rule throughout.
